name: DruidHUD: Hidden Ladders
creator: Dryw
summary: A field guide to the numbers Daggerfall Online doesn't show you
description: The game doesn't tell you a shop is quality 19 or a dungeon ranks 21. It gives you hints instead: a shop that greets you with incense and soft music, a dungeon called a Coven on the travel map.
This guide turns those hints into numbers you can use. Set your Luck, level and Renown in the character panel, and every section below updates to match your character.

features.name: Character Panel
features.text: Set your Luck, character level and Renown once, and every section updates to match. These are saved in your browser

features.name: Shops
features.text: Shop quality, pricing and rare-ingredient stock by tier.

features.name: Town Economy
features.text: Town economy scores, and how certain activities moves them.

features.name: Dungeons
features.text: Dungeon types with their metal and magic drop rankings.

features.name: Weapon Metals
features.text: Metal requirements, damage penalties and special foe weaknesses.

features.name: Loot
features.text: Loot rarity odds, bad-luck protection and Gilded boss drops.

features.name: Gems
features.text: Gem grades, socket rules and gem caps.

features.name: Crafting Writs
features.text: Daily crafting writs, their pay and the potions they accept.

features.name: Enchanting
features.text: Enchanting costs, soul trade-offs and enchantment room.

features.name: Level and Renown
features.text: How your level and Renown affect spawns, Abyss events and rewards.

features.name: Calendar & Holidays
features.text: Holidays and the order of the months.

features.name: Quiz
features.text: General knowledge quiz to make sure you know what your doing.

name: Ohrion: Daggerfall Watch
creator: Ohrion
summary: A tool to display Event Timers and Player Vendor information
description: Ohrion's tool allows you to track events outside of the game window, as well as see information on Gilded Drops and Player Vendor listings and locations in ways that the base client does not make readily available

features.name: Event Watch
features.text: A list of timers for all events, track exactly when they will happen and view the possible loot tables.

features.name: Gilded Drops
features.text: Filter events to only show the ones that will have Gilded Drops, and see what those drops are.

features.name: Vendor Database
features.text: See transparently what people are selling on the market boards, who listed items, and where they are located.
